title: When AUC Meets Generative Reconstruction: A Unified Principle for Balanced Visual Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.22094v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) require visual encoders that extract fine-grained visual features while constructing semantically disentangled and discriminative representations. Conventional methodologies encounter a fundamental trade-off: contrastive learning enhances inter-class discrimination by suppressing intra-class variability, whereas generative reconstruction emphasizes perceptual fidelity but lacks explicit comparative supervision. The naive aggregation of these objectives via composite loss functions often induces optimization conflicts and instability due to gradient interference within the shared latent space. To resolve this, we introduce a unified representation-learning paradigm that reformulates generative reconstruction as a discriminative ranking problem within the generative output manifold. translated_title: 当AUC遇上生成式重建：平衡视觉表征学习的统一原则
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）需要视觉编码器在提取细粒度视觉特征的同时，构建语义解耦且具有判别性的表征。传统方法面临一个根本性的权衡：对比学习通过抑制类内变异性来增强类间判别能力，而生成式重建强调感知保真度，但缺乏显式的对比监督。通过复合损失函数简单地将这些目标聚合在一起，往往会由于共享潜在空间中的梯度干扰而引发优化冲突和不稳定性。为解决这一问题，我们引入了一种统一的表征学习范式，将生成式重建重新表述为生成输出流形上的判别排序问题。我们的方法将感知重建保留为监督信号，并集成了基于排序的判别……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出将生成式重建重新表述为判别排序问题的统一表征学习范式，解决了对比学习与生成重建之间的目标冲突，实现了细粒度感知与判别能力兼顾的平衡视觉表征学习。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified representation-learning paradigm that reformulates generative reconstruction as a discriminative ranking problem, resolving the conflict between contrastive learning and generative reconstruction to achieve balanced visual representations with both fine-grained perception and discriminability.
